goal: A shared offline decision-model component (scripts/decision-model/) resolves one provider profile from the user-local .imm/decision-models.local.json and the tracked .imm/decision-bindings.json, enforces the sensitive-input egress allowlist before any request, calls Clef through Workers AI REST or a fake provider, validates the answer and returns a result envelope or an unavailable reason; the A14 PR comment triage eval (scripts/decision-eval/a14/) extracts a corpus from saved imm-pr-diag JSON and writes a dated JSON and Markdown report against the all_blocking baseline (#204, #286; Spec docs/specs/decision-model-core.spec.md D1-D8).

acceptance.assertion: In tests/decision-model.test.ts, decide() with a temp root resolves bindings[point] over default_profile, and a bindings key present with null returns unavailable/no_binding even when default_profile is non-null; default_profile null with no binding returns no_binding; a missing local file returns no_local_config; a binding naming a profile absent from the local file returns unknown_profile; malformed JSON, an unknown top-level or profile key, an unknown application point in bindings and an unknown provider kind each return config_invalid; a jev profile returns unsupported_provider_kind; and none of these cases invokes the injected fetch (Spec D2, D3).

In tests/decision-model.test.ts, for an application point with a sensitive input category (diff) and an egress map that does not list it for the profile's kind, decide() returns unavailable/egress_denied with a detail naming the category and the kind, and the injected fetch records zero calls (fake kind included, which records zero adapter invocations); with egress listing diff for clef the same request reaches fetch exactly once; listing a non-sensitive category (pr_comment) in egress returns config_invalid (Spec D4).

In tests/decision-model.test.ts, a clef profile with a stubbed fetch returning {success:true,result:{model,answers,usage}} yields a decided envelope, and the recorded request is POST https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/<env account id>/ai/run/@cf/cloudflare/clef with Authorization Bearer <env token> and a body holding model, state and one choice question keyed by the point id with the registry's criteria; an unset token env returns credential_missing with zero fetch calls; HTTP 500 and success:false return provider_error; probability keys differing from the option set, a probability sum of 1.002 and a choice outside the option set return invalid_response while a sum of 1.0009 is accepted; a fetch that never resolves within timeout_ms returns provider_error with detail timeout; usage.input_tokens equal to floor(0.99*context_window) gives truncation possible and one less gives none; and no result detail contains the token or account id value (Spec D5).

In tests/decision-model.test.ts, a fake profile returns an envelope with exactly the fields application_point, question_type, option_set, probabilities, choice, confidence, provider_kind, profile, model, model_version, threshold_set_version, input_tokens, context_window and truncation, with threshold_set_version a14/v0 for a14_pr_comment_triage and truncation unknown; a fake adapter that throws returns unavailable/provider_error instead of throwing; and an import scan finds no import of plugins/immune-brain/runtime or plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension in scripts/decision-model or scripts/decision-eval, and no import of scripts/decision-model or scripts/decision-eval under plugins/immune-brain (Spec D1, D5, D6).

In tests/decision-eval-a14.test.ts, scripts/decision-eval/a14/extract.ts run on tests/fixtures/decision-eval/a14/pr-diag-sample.json writes one corpus row per review thread, non-empty PR comment and non-empty review body, with id <repository>#<number>/<thread|comment|review>/<item id>, gold unlabeled and rows sorted by id, and writes no row for an empty-body comment or review; re-extraction into a corpus holding a labelled row keeps its gold, labeler and labelled_at and keeps a row absent from the new diag; an existing row with gold "maybe" exits 1 printing invalid_gold_label and leaves the corpus file byte-identical (Spec D7).

In tests/decision-eval-a14.test.ts, scripts/decision-eval/a14/run.ts with --date 2026-11-01, a temp local config whose default profile is fake and a 4-row labelled corpus writes a14-2026-11-01.json with contract immune_brain/decision_eval_report/v1, counts, metrics (accuracy, decided_accuracy, macro_f1, per_class, brier, ece, coverage_at for 0.50..0.95), baseline all_blocking with accuracy and macro_f1, and cases[] each holding gold and either an envelope or {unavailable: reason}, plus a14-2026-11-01.md listing each case's choice, every option probability, model, model version, threshold-set version and truncation; when one case is unavailable, accuracy is lower than decided_accuracy; a corpus with no labelled rows exits 1 printing no_labelled_cases; and when every case is unavailable the run exits 2 printing no_cases_decided with the JSON report still written (Spec D8; BR-SCN-1).

In tests/decision-model.test.ts, the committed .imm/decision-bindings.json parses to exactly {contract: immune_brain/decision_bindings/v1, default_profile: default, bindings: {}, egress: {}}, git check-ignore reports .imm/decision-models.local.json as ignored, and CONTEXT.md defines the term Decision model and names scripts/decision-model/ (Spec D3).
